note: Bare-earth ground height (buildings and bridges removed), metres above Ordnance Datum Newlyn. Cells of 25 m in the app's projection (LAT0 51.507, LON0 -0.12), row-major from the south-west corner. Each cell holds the lowest and highest ~6 m pixel in it, in decimetres. lo and spread: base64 LEB128 varints, one per cell; lo holds zigzag(lo - previous lo), previous being the cell to the left, or the first cell of the row below at a row start; spread holds hi - lo. Built by data/sea-level-build/build.js.
